recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, three-tier horizontal composition featuring an extreme close-up of a person's eyes as the central focal point, framed by bold typographic headers and a detailed tracklist footer against a dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal banding separating text and image zones
Extreme close-up photography emphasizing emotional expression
Vibrant neon-adjacent text colors against a deep black field
Strict alignment of text blocks to the left and right margins
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the central subject
Use of heavy, wide sans-serif typefaces
Thin horizontal rules separating the image from text blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's eyes occupy the central horizontal band, scaled to fill the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The person's eyes, specifically the direct gaze and emotional detail, serve as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting with the large title, moving to the artist name, then the eyes, and finally the tracklist and logo in the footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial black negative space in the top and bottom thirds to allow typography to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones (ochre, brown, amber) in the central photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta and lime green for primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in text elements against low-value, dark backgrounds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Wide, heavy sans-serif with geometric influences.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' with a straight, angled descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting colors (Magenta/Green) with similar heavy weights but differing widths.
graphicDevices: Boxed logo element in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric display feel of the top header.
Captures the dense, impactful nature of the artist name and tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-tier layout. The top and bottom thirds are solid black. The middle third is a cinematic, extreme close-up of a person's eyes, focusing on the bridge of the nose to the eyebrows. Use warm, grainy 1960s film photography style with high contrast. Add thin magenta horizontal lines separating the image from the black sections.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, wide sans-serif title in magenta at the top. Below it, place an all-caps artist name in lime green. In the bottom section, add a left-aligned bulleted list in white sans-serif. Place a small lime-green boxed logo in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the image restricted to the middle horizontal band?
Are the colors magenta and lime green used for the primary text?
Is the typography heavy and sans-serif?
Is there a clear horizontal rule separating the image from the text?

adjustableVariables: Specific accent colors (e.g., swapping magenta for cyan)
Number of tracks in the footer list
postGenerationChecks: Check for 1960s-style film grain in the photo section.
Ensure the magenta lines are perfectly horizontal and thin.
Verify the text does not overlap the central image.
Confirm the tracklist is left-aligned with bullet points.
recipe.reuseFormula: Divide frame into 1:1:1 horizontal bands. Fill center with extreme close-up photo. Use black background for outer bands. Apply bold, wide sans-serif type in neon colors to the black areas, separated by thin rules.
